description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the ReportingMethodConfigurationService in the OrangeHRM project. It tests various service methods related to reporting methods, including listing, retrieving by ID or name, deleting, saving, and counting reporting methods.

classes.name: ReportingMethodConfigurationServiceTest
classes.description: Test suite for the ReportingMethodConfigurationService class, verifying CRUD operations and data retrieval for reporting methods.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creating an instance of the service and populating test data.

methods.name: testGetReportingMethodList
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of reporting methods with mocked DAO response.

methods.name: testGetReportingMethodById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a reporting method by ID with mocked DAO response.

methods.name: testDeleteReportingMethods
methods.description: Tests deleting reporting methods and expects a count of deleted items.

methods.name: testGetReportingMethodByName
methods.description: Tests retrieving a reporting method by name with mocked DAO response.

methods.name: testSaveReportingMethod
methods.description: Tests saving a new reporting method and expects the same object returned.

methods.name: testGetReportingMethodCount
methods.description: Tests counting reporting methods with mocked DAO response.
